config.study: Retrospective leave-study-out prediction of aquatic biomass slopes
config.status: Exploratory held-out-by-fitting reanalysis; all source data have previously been inspected
config.resource: Reported biomass; object cost proportional to body mass in each source study's units
config.coordinate: Reported body mass; slopes invariant to constant changes of mass units

excluded_studies.StudyID_07: Known invalid upper size bounds; no correction inferred from slopes

config.primary_errors: Directly reported finite positive SlopeSE only
config.sensitivity_errors: Direct SE preferred; otherwise ordered confidence-bound width divided by 3.92 under an unverified 95%-Gaussian assumption
config.training_weights: Equal total weight per study, then equal weight per row within study
config.location_estimator: Weighted mean; the held-out study is excluded from every fitted quantity
config.shared_spread_estimator: max(0, weighted centered slope variance minus weighted squared standard error)
config.primary_score: Mean held-out log predictive density per study, aggregated with equal study weights
config.point_sensitivity: All eligible slopes, comparing -1 against the training median of study medians by held-study mean absolute error
config.inference: Descriptive overlapping-fold transport scores; no independent-fold p-value or population equivalence verdict
config.randomness: Deterministic selection, fitting, and scoring; no random seed

assessment_status: Retrospective reanalysis, held-out by fitting only; source results already inspected
